# ankra_cluster_os_patch_policy (Resource)

The rolling OS security-patch policy of a cluster Ankra provisions on Ankra Cloud, AWS, DigitalOcean, Hetzner, OVHcloud, Scaleway or UpCloud (`ankra cluster os-patches policy`): whether Ankra patches the cluster's hosts on its own, one host at a time, inside a weekly maintenance window in UTC, how often, whether it may drain nodes that carry single-replica stateful workloads, and after how many days held-back security updates count as a security lag. Only the attributes set in configuration are written; an unset attribute keeps the stored value (or the platform default: disabled, Monday to Thursday 02:00 UTC for 4 hours, weekly, stateful nodes skipped, 14 days) and reports it. Turning the policy off while a patch run is in flight is refused. Destroy leaves the policy as it is, so an enabled policy keeps patching: set `enabled = false` and apply before destroying the resource to stop it. Needs an Ankra platform from 2026-11-08 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_cluster_os_patch_policy" "prod" {
  cluster_id            = "0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666"
  enabled               = true
  window_days           = ["sat", "sun"]
  window_start_hour_utc = 1
  window_duration_hours = 4
  cadence_days          = 7
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the cluster. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `cadence_days` (Number) Minimum number of days between two automatic runs, 1 to 90.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Ankra starts a patch run on its own inside the window, at most once per `cadence_days`. A run drains, patches and can reboot every host. A run can be started by hand either way.
- `include_stateful_nodes` (Boolean) Whether a run may drain nodes that carry single-replica stateful workloads and database node pools. Off, they are skipped and reported.
- `security_lag_days` (Number) Days held-back security updates may stay pending before the cluster reports a security lag, 1 to 90.
- `window_days` (Set of String) Days the window opens on: `mon`, `tue`, `wed`, `thu`, `fri`, `sat` or `sun`. A window that runs past midnight belongs to the day it opened on.
- `window_duration_hours` (Number) How long the window stays open, 1 to 12 hours.
- `window_start_hour_utc` (Number) Hour the window opens at, in UTC, 0 to 23.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_kind` (String) Kind of the cluster, resolved from the platform; it selects the API lane.
- `id` (String) The cluster id.
- `window_description` (String) The window in words, as the platform describes it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by cluster id.
terraform import ankra_cluster_os_patch_policy.prod 0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666
```
